note:
Guillotine: Winter Slayer — AR/Water. Board: 1.024 OK on 1 graded comp. Kit-faithfulness is pinned test-first in scripts/tests/units/guillotine-winter-slayer.test.ts (18 tests). SKIPS: none — every kit line is represented.
HERO LEVEL is a derived currency: EXP +1 per 3 core hits, 10 EXP = +1 Hero Level, cap 11. The core branch dominates at scope-lock core exposure 1.0, so ~30 hits per level puts her at level 11 in ~25s of firing (~28s wall at 60 ammo / 81f reload). It is tracked as a `heroLevel` resource pool (initial 1, max 11), incremented once per hitCount-30 level-up.
THE LEVEL-UP REWARDS ARE CAPPED AT 10 FIRINGS and the cap is load-bearing, not cosmetic: the kit arithmetic self-closes at S2's EXP cap of 100 ÷ 10 EXP per level = 10 level-ups = Level 1 → 11, so there is no 11th reward. Both reward blocks (instantReload 0.1026 and the heal event) carry resourceGate {heroLevel max 10}. Without it the hitCount-30 trigger fires ~56 times over a fight.
S1 auras (PRESERVED, measured-accurate): Water-ally passives at the level-11 steady state — elemAdvantageDamagePct 1.16 x 11 = 12.76 and casterAtkPct 0.91 x 11 = 10.01. The level-up 'Recovers 2.44% of final Max HP' is a heal EVENT block on the same hitCount-30 cadence, self-targeted and event-only: zero self-damage impact, present so recovery-consumer teammates (crown-style) see the proc.
S2: the EXP ATK stack is hitCount 3 x atkPct 1.81, maxStacks 100 (+181% at cap, reached ~32s wall; the engine ramps the stack natively, so no haircut is applied). 'Hero Level 2 or above' → elemAdvantageDamagePct 7.46 as a passive, since level 2 arrives ~3s in and the first-3s over-credit is negligible.
BURST (PRESERVED, measured-accurate): Water-ally attackDamagePct 10.14 + elemAdvantageDamagePct 18.75 (10s), and a 229.57%/s dot for 10s on the boss (= 20.87 x 11, the level-11 snapshot).
Her burst damage is a `dot` AND its kit clause carries a qualifying burst-amp literal, which makes her STRUCTURALLY amp-ineligible however she is tagged — burstDesc is authorable on flatDamage only. That is an engine gap, not a tagging decision. There is nothing to tag here; do not try.
⚑1 CADENCE TUPLE (top priority, escalated): pullsPerSec 12 (datamined rate_of_fire 720) + reloadFrames 81. Her measured residual already reads normal-fire ~26% HOT against these values, and 12 / 1.26 ≈ 9.5/s is the arithmetic suspect. OWNER RULING: do NOT refit by fudge — pin it with a focus video (rounds/min + reload gap), then fix via charFixes.
⚑2 EXP BUILD BLEND: shipped at 3 hits/stack, i.e. 100% core. The realised core-hit fraction is exposure x ACR, and ACR < 1 for an AR without hit-rate support, so non-core hits DO occur and the true cadence is slower. If the real core fraction is c < 1 the effective rate is 1 / (c/3 + (1-c)/6), somewhere in [3, 6]. Recipe: focus video, count hits between level-up procs (30 hits/level is the pure-core branch).
⚑3 LEVEL-11 STEADY-STATE COLLAPSE (low): the auras are passive at full value from t=0 with no ~25s ramp haircut, AND the burst DoT snapshots level 11 on EVERY cast including the first — which lands at ~5s on an early B1→B2→B3 chain, well before level 11 is reached, so the first burst's DoT is over-credited (later ~40s-cooldown bursts genuinely do reach level 11). Both are deliberate steady-state approximations and the measured residual calls the burst DoT and the Hero-Level auras accurate, so they stand unless a future solo read disagrees. Recipe if ever refit: ramp the auras at 1.16 x L / 0.91 x L over the level trajectory, and snapshot the DoT at cast-time level.
caveats: skill1/skill2: normal-fire cadence (12/s, reloadFrames 81) is datamined and the measured residual reads ~26% hot against it — flagged for video measurement and deliberately NOT refit (⚑1, owner ruling).

skill2: the EXP build rate is modeled at 3 hits/stack (the core branch at scope-lock 100% core exposure); the blend with the 6-hit non-core branch is an unmeasured estimate, and since ACR < 1 for an AR without hit-rate support the true rate is slower (⚑2).
skill2: Elemental Advantage Attack Damage 7.46% is modeled as a passive — Hero Level 2 is reached ~3s into the fight, so the over-credit is negligible.

skill1: the two level-up reward blocks are capped at 10 firings by resourceGate {heroLevel max 10}. The cap is load-bearing kit arithmetic (EXP cap 100 ÷ 10 per level = 10 level-ups = Level 1 → 11, so no 11th reward); uncapped, the hitCount-30 trigger fires ~56 times per fight.

burst: her burst damage is a `dot` and its kit clause carries a qualifying burst-amp literal, so she is STRUCTURALLY amp-ineligible however she is tagged — burstDesc is authorable on flatDamage only. Engine gap, not a tagging decision; nothing to tag.

skill1/burst: the Hero-Level auras and the burst DoT both snapshot the level-11 steady state (auras full-value from t=0 with no ramp; the DoT at 20.87 x 11 on every cast, including the ~5s first burst that precedes level 11). Deliberate approximations, called measured-accurate by the residual (⚑3).
